references.text: God's promise to the fathers concerning the land that Israel was to inherit, linked to the oath God swore to Abraham.
God's oath to Isaac to give the land to his descendants, part of the promise to the fathers.
Joseph reminds of God's oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob regarding the land.
God reminds Moses of the oath he swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob concerning the land.
The image of God carrying Israel as a father carries his child, parallel to the care of a nurse.
The Lord as a shepherd who carries the lambs in his bosom, a similar image of care.
Kings and queens as foster fathers and nurses for Israel, a similar image of care.
The context where Moses complains about the burden of leading the people alone.
Moses continues his complaint that he cannot carry the people alone.
Paul uses the image of a nursing mother who nourishes her children, a similar image of care for leadership.
